description: FDA drug shortage records from openFDA, most recently updated first, with optional drug-name and status filters (current, to be discontinued, resolved). Name filters match every word in generic name, brand or presentation, plus RxNorm ingredients for brand names. Entries give generic name, presentation, dosage form, status, availability, related info, reason, therapeutic category, company, ISO dates and package NDC, plus counts by status and an in_shortage flag. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

q.description: Drug name (generic or brand). Omit for the most recently updated shortages.

status.description: Status filter. Default current without q, all with q.

name: rx_shortages
title: FDA drug shortages
